svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 2 lengths of 1910 mm from 1 in EMT.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw square (a pipe cutter or a fine blade); deburr inside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and out with a reamer and a file, and wipe clean.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark one line along the whole tube with a straight edge. Every hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: is on that line: the button hole at end A on the line, the button

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hole at end B on the opposite side (turn the tube half a turn).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Centre punch, drill 3 mm, then 6 mm for the button holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No hitch pin holes in the ridge tubes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Colour band (ridge colour) at each end, 70 mm in; it tells

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: them from the rafters, which are the same tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit a 1 in snap button in each end until it clicks.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both ends click into ridge node sockets.
